    //==
    // # The half-edge mesh's own members
    //
    // The interface obligations of HalfEdgeMesh (`topology.types.plato`):
    // IDeformable3D, the IMeshElementCounts triple, and the five IHalfEdge
    // steps. Every navigation step is one array read — that constant-time
    // neighbourhood walk is the entire reason the structure stores what it stores.
    //
    // Boundary convention (see the type's doc comment): -1 means "none", so a
    // half-edge on a boundary has Twin = -1 and a half-edge running along a hole has
    // IFace = -1. The steps below return that sentinel rather than failing; a caller
    // walking a loop tests for it.

    // The IDeformable3D obligation: every vertex position carried through the
    // mapping, connectivity unchanged.
    Deform(self: HalfEdgeMesh, mapping: Function1<Point3D, Point3D>): HalfEdgeMesh
        => (self.Positions.Map(mapping),
            self.HalfEdges,
            self.FaceHalfEdges,
            self.VertexHalfEdges);
